title: Design System: E-jay P. Detera Portfolio

label.purpose: Tabular indices, dates, stack badges, and repo links.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Color and border transitions on bay hover.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Rectilinear ochre action button for primary dispatch and navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #E5A93C; color: #0C0C0E; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f2b94f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F3EF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Repository Link Control
components.description: Flush rectilinear link control for GitHub source code links.
components.css: .ds-btn-repo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #19191D; color: #F4F3EF; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid #26262B; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-repo:hover { border-color: #E5A93C; color: #E5A93C; }

components.name: Stack Specification Tag
components.description: Monospace technical tag for languages, databases, and SDKs.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #19191D; color: #C8C6BE; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid #26262B; }

narrative.overview: This design system treats a software engineer's portfolio as an open technical monograph and architectural specification rather than a marketing SaaS template. Built on exposed 1px structural glazing mullions (#26262B) over a matte warm-carbon ground (#0C0C0E), every project, experience milestone, and credential sits inside a crisp rectilinear bay where hierarchy comes from typographic scale and structural division rather than glowing neon borders or floating drop-shadow cards.
keyCharacteristics: Exposed 1px solid #26262B structural mullion grid framing a 1280px (max-w-7xl) central dossier column.
Three-voice typography pairing industrial Archivo display headlines, readable Plus Jakarta Sans technical prose, and tabular JetBrains Mono specification metadata.
Open-by-default case study architecture where system highlights, database decisions, and repository links are visible in a single scroll.

rules.name: The Three-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every non-hero section is restricted to Warm Paper/Stone text, Carbon/Charcoal grounds, and functional Ochre/Vermilion specification highlights—never multi-color gradients or glowing colored box-shadows.

rules.name: The Monospace Discipline Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved strictly for tabular metadata, indices, dates, stack tags, and action controls—never for multi-sentence body paragraphs.

rules.name: The Glazing Mullion Rule
rules.body: Adjacent bays share a single 1px solid #26262B dividing line (divide-x / divide-y) rather than floating as separate rounded cards with outer margins and drop shadows.

dos: Do expose all flagship project architecture highlights directly inline so recruiters never have to click a modal just to read technical depth.
Do use tabular-nums on every index (SYS-01, CRD-01), counter, and date range.
Do pair Archivo headings with Plus Jakarta Sans body prose for scannable hierarchy.
donts: Don't set body paragraphs in JetBrains Mono.
Don't hide 4–8 portfolio items inside pagination carousels or touch-swipe sliders.
Don't use glowing neon shadows, glassmorphism cards, or unbacked 4-column SaaS feature rows.
